title: The category of finite etale schemes and its base change functors
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. A *finite etale $Y$-scheme* is a scheme $U$ with a morphism $p:U\to Y$ that is finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] and etale [def-weil-etale-morphism]. The category $\mathsf{FEt}(Y)$ has as objects the finite etale $Y$-schemes and as morphisms $(U,p)\to(V,q)$ the $Y$-morphisms, i.e. the morphisms of schemes $\varphi:U\to V$ with $q\circ\varphi=p$ (every such $\varphi$ is itself finite etale, but no condition is imposed). For a morphism of schemes $g:Y'\to Y$, the *base change functor* $g^*:\mathsf{FEt}(Y)\to\mathsf{FEt}(Y')$ sends $U$ to the fibre product $U\times_YY'$ [def-pc-base-change] with its second projection (finite and etale, since both properties are stable under base change) and a $Y$-morphism $\varphi$ to $\varphi\times_YY'$. For $U\in\mathsf{FEt}(Y)$ we also write $U_{Y'}=g^*U$.
